parameters.query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
WITH n ORDER BY n.name
WITH collect(n) AS nodes
WITH nodes, range(0, size(nodes)-1) AS idxs
WITH nodes, idxs,
     [i IN idxs | [j IN idxs WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (nodes[j])-[:LINK]->(nodes[i]) } | j]] AS incoming,
     [j IN idxs | COUNT { (nodes[j])-[:LINK]->() }] AS outdegrees
WITH nodes, idxs, incoming, outdegrees,
     toFloat(reduce(s = 0, d IN outdegrees | s + d)) / size(nodes) AS avgOutdegree
WITH nodes, idxs, incoming, outdegrees, avgOutdegree,
     reduce(scores = [i IN idxs | CASE WHEN nodes[i].name = 'Paddington' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END],
            iteration IN range(1, 100) |
            [i IN idxs |
              CASE WHEN nodes[i].name = 'Paddington' THEN 0.2 ELSE 0.0 END
              + 0.8 * reduce(total = 0.0, j IN incoming[i] |
                  total + scores[j] / (outdegrees[j] + avgOutdegree))
            ]) AS scores
UNWIND idxs AS i
WITH nodes[i].name AS station, scores[i] AS score, avgOutdegree
WHERE station IN ['Paddington', 'Bayswater']
RETURN station, score, avgOutdegree ORDER BY station

question: Could you run the bridges algorithm to find out the number of relationships that disconnect the graph? Give the answer as relationships:x. Do not emit anything else.

tools.name: mcp__gds-agent__get_neo4j_schema

parameters.query:
MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]-(b:UndergroundStation)
WHERE elementId(a) < elementId(b)
WITH a, b, count(DISTINCT r) AS relationshipMultiplicity
RETURN min(relationshipMultiplicity) AS minimumMultiplicity,
       count(CASE WHEN relationshipMultiplicity = 1 THEN 1 END) AS singleRelationshipPairs,
       count(*) AS connectedStationPairs

WITH count(r) AS m
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)

MATCH ()-[r:LINK]->()
WHERE startNode(r).rail = community AND endNode(r).rail = community

tools.name: mcp__gds-agent__read_neo4j_cypher

parameters.query:
MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[:LINK]-(an:UndergroundStation)
WITH a, collect(DISTINCT an) AS aNeighbors
MATCH (b:UndergroundStation)-[:LINK]-(bn:UndergroundStation)
WHERE a <> b
WITH a, aNeighbors, b, collect(DISTINCT bn) AS bNeighbors
WITH a, b, aNeighbors, bNeighbors,
     [x IN aNeighbors WHERE x IN bNeighbors] AS common
WHERE size(common) > 0
RETURN a.name AS station1, b.name AS station2,
       toFloat(size(common)) / sqrt(toFloat(size(aNeighbors) * size(bNeighbors))) AS similarity
ORDER BY similarity DESC, station1, station2
LIMIT 8

parameters.query:
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation {name: 'Sloane Square'})-[:LINK]-(sn:UndergroundStation)
WITH s, collect(DISTINCT sn) AS sNeighbors
MATCH (c:UndergroundStation)
WHERE c.name IN ['Knightsbridge', 'Acton Town', 'Green Park', 'Pimlico']
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:LINK]-(cn:UndergroundStation)
WITH c, sNeighbors, collect(DISTINCT cn) AS cNeighbors
WITH c,
     [x IN sNeighbors WHERE x IN cNeighbors] AS intersection,
     sNeighbors + [x IN cNeighbors WHERE NOT x IN sNeighbors] AS unionSet
RETURN c.name AS station,
       toFloat(size(intersection)) / size(unionSet) AS similarity
ORDER BY similarity DESC, station

parameters.query:
CALL gds.allShortestPaths.delta.stream($graph,{sourceNode:$sourceId,relationshipTypes:['LINK'],relationshipWeightProperty:'time',delta:50.0}) YIELD targetNode,costs
WITH collect({target:targetNode,cost:last(costs)}) AS deltaRows
CALL gds.allShortestPaths.dijkstra.stream($graph,{sourceNode:$sourceId,relationshipTypes:['LINK'],relationshipWeightProperty:'time'}) YIELD targetNode,totalCost
WITH deltaRows,collect({target:targetNode,cost:totalCost}) AS dijkstraRows
RETURN size(deltaRows) AS deltaCount,size(dijkstraRows) AS dijkstraCount,size([x IN deltaRows WHERE NOT any(y IN dijkstraRows WHERE y.target=x.target AND y.cost=x.cost)]) AS mismatchCount

parameters.query:
MATCH p=(s:UndergroundStation {name: $start})-[:LINK*1..5]->(t:UndergroundStation {name: $end})
WHERE all(n IN nodes(p) WHERE single(m IN nodes(p) WHERE m = n))
WITH p, reduce(cost = 0.0, r IN relationships(p) | cost + toFloat(r.time)) AS totalCost
ORDER BY totalCost ASC, length(p) ASC
LIMIT 1
RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.name] AS path,
       reduce(costs = [0.0], r IN relationships(p) | costs + [costs[-1] + toFloat(r.time)]) AS costs,
       totalCost

CALL gds.shortestPath.dijkstra.stream($graphName, {
  sourceNode: source,
  relationshipWeightProperty: 'distance'
})

ORDER BY totalCost, gds.util.asNode(targetNode).name

CALL gds.allShortestPaths.delta.stream($graphName, {
  sourceNode: source,
  relationshipWeightProperty: 'distance',
  delta: 1.0
})
YIELD targetNode, totalCost, nodeIds, costs

ORDER BY totalCost, gds.util.asNode(targetNode).name
LIMIT 3

CALL {
  CALL gds.graph.relationshipProperty.stream($dijkstraGraph, 'totalCost', ['ARSENAL_DISTANCE_PATH'])
  YIELD targetNodeId, propertyValue
  RETURN collect({target: targetNodeId, cost: propertyValue}) AS dijkstra
}
CALL {
  CALL gds.graph.relationshipProperty.stream($bellmanGraph, 'totalCost', ['ARSENAL_BELLMAN_PATH'])
  YIELD targetNodeId, propertyValue
  RETURN collect({target: targetNodeId, cost: propertyValue}) AS bellman
}
UNWIND dijkstra AS d
WITH d, bellman, [b IN bellman WHERE b.target = d.target][0] AS b
RETURN count(d) AS comparedTargets,
       sum(CASE WHEN b IS NULL OR b.cost <> d.cost THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatches,
       max(abs(d.cost - b.cost)) AS maxAbsoluteDifference

ORDER BY totalCost, station

parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation) RETURN id(s) AS nodeId, s.name AS name ORDER BY nodeId

MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
WITH collect([id(n)]) AS initialComponents
CALL {
  MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation)
  WITH CASE WHEN id(a) < id(b) THEN id(a) ELSE id(b) END AS aId,
       CASE WHEN id(a) < id(b) THEN id(b) ELSE id(a) END AS bId,
       min(toFloat(r.time)) AS weight
  ORDER BY weight, aId, bId
  RETURN collect({a:aId, b:bId, weight:weight}) AS edges
}
WITH reduce(state = {components: initialComponents, selected: []}, e IN edges |
  CASE WHEN any(c IN state.components WHERE e.a IN c AND e.b IN c)
    THEN state
    ELSE {
      components: [c IN state.components WHERE NOT (e.a IN c OR e.b IN c)] +
                  [reduce(merged = [], c IN state.components |
                    CASE WHEN e.a IN c OR e.b IN c THEN merged + c ELSE merged END)],
      selected: state.selected + e
    }
  END
) AS result
RETURN size(result.selected) AS edgeCount,
       reduce(total = 0.0, e IN result.selected | total + e.weight) AS totalWeight,
       size(result.components) AS componentCount

question: Find the minimum directed steiner tree from Bank to Waterloo, Southwark and Westminster. I want the output to be in the format of a sequence of [node, parent, weight]. For example: ["A", "B", 2.0], ["A", "C", 3.0], ["K", "L", 9.5].
agent_answer:
["Waterloo", "Bank", 4.0], ["Southwark", "Waterloo", 1.0], ["Westminster", "Waterloo", 2.0]

Total weight: **7.0**. The minimum total was independently verified; another equal-weight tree also exists.

tools.name: mcp__gds-agent__get_neo4j_schema

parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE s.name IN $names OR s.display_name IN $names RETURN s.name AS name, s.display_name AS display_name, s.id AS id ORDER BY name
MATCH ()-[r:LINK]->() RETURN min(r.distance) AS minDistance, max(r.distance) AS maxDistance, min(r.time) AS minTime, max(r.time) AS maxTime, count(*) AS links, count(DISTINCT r.line) AS lines
MATCH ()-[r:LINK]->() RETURN count(CASE WHEN r.distance <> r.time THEN 1 END) AS differing, collect(DISTINCT [r.distance, r.time])[0..20] AS samplePairs

tools.name: mcp__gds-agent__minimum_directed_steiner_tree

parameters.query:
MATCH (b:UndergroundStation {name:'Bank'}),
      (t1:UndergroundStation {name:'Waterloo'}),
      (t2:UndergroundStation {name:'Southwark'}),
      (t3:UndergroundStation {name:'Westminster'})
CALL (b,t1) {
  MATCH p=(b)-[:LINK*1..7]->(t1)
  WHERE all(n IN nodes(p) WHERE single(m IN nodes(p) WHERE m = n))
    AND reduce(s=0, r IN relationships(p) | s + r.distance) <= 7
  RETURN collect(relationships(p)) AS p1s
}
CALL (b,t2) {
  MATCH p=(b)-[:LINK*1..7]->(t2)
  WHERE all(n IN nodes(p) WHERE single(m IN nodes(p) WHERE m = n))
    AND reduce(s=0, r IN relationships(p) | s + r.distance) <= 7
  RETURN collect(relationships(p)) AS p2s
}
CALL (b,t3) {
  MATCH p=(b)-[:LINK*1..7]->(t3)
  WHERE all(n IN nodes(p) WHERE single(m IN nodes(p) WHERE m = n))
    AND reduce(s=0, r IN relationships(p) | s + r.distance) <= 7
  RETURN collect(relationships(p)) AS p3s
}
UNWIND p1s AS p1
UNWIND p2s AS p2
UNWIND p3s AS p3
WITH reduce(acc=[], r IN p1+p2+p3 |
       CASE WHEN any(x IN acc WHERE elementId(x)=elementId(r)) THEN acc ELSE acc+r END) AS rs
WITH rs, reduce(total=0.0, r IN rs | total + toFloat(r.distance)) AS totalWeight
ORDER BY totalWeight ASC
LIMIT 1
RETURN totalWeight,
       [r IN rs | [startNode(r).name, endNode(r).name, toFloat(r.distance)]] AS directedEdges

UNWIND $edges AS e
MATCH (p:UndergroundStation {name:e.parent})-[r:LINK]->(n:UndergroundStation {name:e.node})
RETURN n.name AS node, p.name AS parent, collect(DISTINCT toFloat(r.distance)) AS weights, collect(DISTINCT r.line) AS lines
ORDER BY CASE n.name WHEN 'Waterloo' THEN 1 WHEN 'Southwark' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

parameters.query:
MATCH (source:UndergroundStation {name: $source})
CALL gds.bellmanFord.stream($graph, {
  sourceNode: id(source),
  relationshipWeightProperty: 'time'
})
YIELD nodeIds, costs, isNegativeCycle
WITH [nodeId IN nodeIds | gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name] AS path, costs, isNegativeCycle
RETURN path, costs, isNegativeCycle
ORDER BY path[size(path)-1]

WITH [nodeId IN nodeIds | gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name] AS path, costs, isNegativeCycle
RETURN path, costs
ORDER BY costs[size(costs)-1], path[size(path)-1]
LIMIT 20

MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation) RETURN count(r) AS directedLinks, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN elementId(a) < elementId(b) THEN [elementId(a),elementId(b)] ELSE [elementId(b),elementId(a)] END) AS unorderedPairs, count(CASE WHEN EXISTS { MATCH (b)-[:LINK]->(a) } THEN 1 END) AS linksWithReverse

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation)
WHERE elementId(a) < elementId(b)
WITH DISTINCT a, b
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  a,
  b,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(a),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(b),
    relationshipType: 'LINK'
  },
  {undirectedRelationshipTypes: ['LINK']}
)

parameters.query:
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation), (t:UndergroundStation)
WHERE elementId(s) < elementId(t)
MATCH p = shortestPath((s)-[:LINK*]-(t))
WITH nodes(p)[1..-1] AS internalNodes
RETURN sum(CASE WHEN any(n IN internalNodes WHERE n.name = "King's Cross St. Pancras") THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS kingsCrossSelectedShortestPaths,
       sum(CASE WHEN any(n IN internalNodes WHERE n.name = 'Angel') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS angelSelectedShortestPaths

parameters.query:
MATCH (c:UndergroundStation {name: $start})
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation)
WHERE s <> c AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (c)-[:LINK*1..]->(s) }
RETURN collect(s.name) AS unreachable, count(s) AS unreachable_count

question: Which 5 stations are geographically closest to Paddington? List the station names in the format ["A", "B", "C"].

tools.name: mcp__gds-agent__get_neo4j_schema

parameters.query: MATCH (p:UndergroundStation) WHERE toLower(p.name) CONTAINS 'paddington' OR toLower(p.display_name) CONTAINS 'paddington' RETURN p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.display_name AS display_name, p.latitude AS latitude, p.longitude AS longitude ORDER BY p.name

MATCH (p:UndergroundStation {name: 'Paddington'}), (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE s <> p WITH s, point.distance(point({latitude: p.latitude, longitude: p.longitude}), point({latitude: s.latitude, longitude: s.longitude})) AS distance_m RETURN s.name AS station, distance_m ORDER BY distance_m ASC, station ASC LIMIT 5

MATCH (p:UndergroundStation {name: 'Paddington'}), (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE s <> p WITH s, radians(s.latitude - p.latitude) AS dlat, radians(s.longitude - p.longitude) AS dlon, radians(p.latitude) AS plat, radians(s.latitude) AS slat WITH s, sin(dlat/2.0)^2 + cos(plat)*cos(slat)*sin(dlon/2.0)^2 AS a WITH s, 2.0 * 6371000.0 * asin(sqrt(a)) AS distance_m RETURN s.name AS station, distance_m ORDER BY distance_m ASC, station ASC LIMIT 5

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[rels:LINK]-(m:UndergroundStation)
WHERE elementId(n) < elementId(m)
WITH n, m, head(collect(rels)) AS r
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    relationshipType: type(r)
  },
  {undirectedRelationshipTypes: ['LINK']}
)

question: Run the bridges (cut-edges) algorithm and report how many edges whose removal would disconnect the graph. Give the answer as relationships:x. Do not emit anything else.

tools.name: mcp__gds-agent__get_neo4j_schema

parameters.query:
MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation)
RETURN count(r) AS relationships,
       count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN elementId(a) < elementId(b) THEN elementId(a)+'|'+elementId(b) ELSE elementId(b)+'|'+elementId(a) END) AS unorderedEndpointPairs,
       count(DISTINCT elementId(a)+'|'+elementId(b)) AS directedEndpointPairs

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation)
WHERE elementId(a) < elementId(b)
WITH DISTINCT a, b
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  a,
  b,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(a),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(b),
    relationshipType: 'LINK'
  },
  {undirectedRelationshipTypes: ['LINK']}
)

WHERE all(r IN rs WHERE NOT (
  (startNode(r) = a AND endNode(r) = b) OR
  (startNode(r) = b AND endNode(r) = a)
))
RETURN count(CASE WHEN p IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS bridgeEndpointPairs

parameters.query: MATCH ()-[r:LINK]->() WITH count(r) AS m MATCH (n:UndergroundStation) OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]-() WITH m, n.rail AS community, count(r) AS degree MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[e:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation) WITH m, community, sum(degree) AS degreeSum, count(CASE WHEN a.rail = community AND b.rail = community THEN 1 END) AS internalEdges RETURN community, m, degreeSum, internalEdges, toFloat(internalEdges)/m - (toFloat(degreeSum)/(2*m))^2 AS modularity ORDER BY community

MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]-()
WITH n.rail AS community, count(r) AS nodeDegree
WITH community, sum(nodeDegree) AS degreeSum
MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[e:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation)
WITH community, degreeSum, count(e) AS m,
     count(CASE WHEN a.rail = community AND b.rail = community THEN 1 END) AS internalEdges
RETURN community, m, degreeSum, internalEdges,
       toFloat(internalEdges)/m - (toFloat(degreeSum)/(2*m))^2 AS modularity
ORDER BY community

WITH count(r) AS rels, count(DISTINCT [a.id,b.id]) AS directedPairs
MATCH (x:UndergroundStation)-[:LINK]->(y:UndergroundStation)
WITH rels, directedPairs, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN x.id < y.id THEN [x.id,y.id] ELSE [y.id,x.id] END) AS unorderedPairs

MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation)
WHERE a.id < b.id
WITH a,b, count(*) AS ab
OPTIONAL MATCH (b)-[r:LINK]->(a)
WITH a,b,ab,count(r) AS ba
RETURN sum(CASE WHEN ba > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reciprocalUnorderedPairs,
       sum(CASE WHEN ba = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oneWayUnorderedPairs,
       max(ab) AS maxParallelForward, max(ba) AS maxParallelReverse

parameters.query:
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation)-[:LINK]->(nbr:UndergroundStation)
WITH s, collect(DISTINCT nbr.id) AS neighbors
WITH collect({s:s, neighbors:neighbors}) AS rows
UNWIND rows AS a
UNWIND rows AS b
WITH a,b, [x IN a.neighbors WHERE x IN b.neighbors] AS common
WITH a.s.name AS station1, b.s.name AS station2,
     toFloat(size(common)) / sqrt(toFloat(size(a.neighbors) * size(b.neighbors))) AS similarity
WHERE station1 <> station2
RETURN station1, station2, similarity

CALL (s) {

}
CALL (c) {
  MATCH (c)-[:LINK]-(cn:UndergroundStation)
  RETURN collect(DISTINCT cn.name) AS cNeighbors
}
WITH c.name AS station, sNeighbors, cNeighbors,

     [x IN sNeighbors WHERE NOT x IN cNeighbors] + cNeighbors AS unionList
RETURN station, toFloat(size(intersection))/size(unionList) AS similarity
ORDER BY similarity DESC, station

tools.name: mcp__gds-agent__read_neo4j_cypher

parameters.query:
MATCH (source:UndergroundStation {name:$sourceName}), (target:UndergroundStation)
WITH source, collect(id(target)) AS targetNodes
CALL gds.shortestPath.dijkstra.stream($graphName,{sourceNode:id(source),targetNodes:targetNodes,relationshipTypes:['LINK'],relationshipWeightProperty:'distance'})
YIELD targetNode,nodeIds,costs
WITH collect({target:targetNode,nodeIds:nodeIds,costs:costs}) AS rows
WITH rows, [r IN rows WHERE size(r.nodeIds)>1 | r.nodeIds[size(r.nodeIds)-2]] AS parentIds
UNWIND [r IN rows WHERE NOT r.target IN parentIds | r] AS leaf
RETURN [nodeId IN leaf.nodeIds | gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name] AS path, leaf.costs AS costs
ORDER BY costs[-1], path

MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation) WITH a,b,r, EXISTS { MATCH (b)-[:LINK]->(a) } AS hasReverse RETURN count(r) AS relationships, sum(CASE WHEN hasReverse THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withReverse, min(r.time) AS minTime, max(r.time) AS maxTime

MATCH p=(s)-[:LINK*1..8]->(t)

  RETURN collect(p1) AS ps1
}
CALL (s) {
  MATCH p2=(s)-[:LINK*1..7]->(:UndergroundStation {name:'Southwark'})
  WHERE reduce(w=0, r IN relationships(p2) | w + r.time) <= 7
  RETURN collect(p2) AS ps2
}
CALL (s) {
  MATCH p3=(s)-[:LINK*1..7]->(:UndergroundStation {name:'Westminster'})
  WHERE reduce(w=0, r IN relationships(p3) | w + r.time) <= 7
  RETURN collect(p3) AS ps3
}
UNWIND ps1 AS p1
UNWIND ps2 AS p2
UNWIND ps3 AS p3
WITH relationships(p1) + relationships(p2) + relationships(p3) AS allRels
UNWIND allRels AS r

WITH treeRels, reduce(total=0.0, r IN treeRels | total + toFloat(r.time)) AS totalWeight

tools.name: mcp__gds-agent__get_neo4j_schema

parameters.query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation) OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
WITH count(DISTINCT n) AS nodes, count(r) AS relationships,
     count(CASE WHEN r.time IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS nullTimes,
     min(r.time) AS minTime, max(r.time) AS maxTime
MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)
RETURN nodes, relationships, nullTimes, minTime, maxTime,
       count(DISTINCT a.name) AS distinctNames,
       collect(a.name)[0..5] AS sampleNames

    relationshipType: CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN null ELSE type(r) END,
    relationshipProperties: CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN {} ELSE {time: toFloat(r.time)} END
  }
)

parameters.query:
MATCH (source:UndergroundStation {name: $source})
CALL gds.bellmanFord.stream($graph, {
  sourceNode: id(source),
  relationshipWeightProperty: 'time'
})
YIELD targetNode, totalCost, nodeIds, costs, isNegativeCycle
RETURN [nodeId IN nodeIds | gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name] AS path,
       costs,
       totalCost,
       isNegativeCycle
ORDER BY totalCost, path

MATCH (source:UndergroundStation {name: $source})
CALL gds.bellmanFord.stream($graph, {sourceNode: id(source), relationshipWeightProperty: 'time'})
YIELD targetNode AS bTarget, totalCost AS bCost
WITH source, collect({target:bTarget, cost:bCost}) AS bf
CALL gds.allShortestPaths.dijkstra.stream($graph, {sourceNodes:[id(source)], relationshipWeightProperty:'time'})
YIELD targetNode AS dTarget, distance AS dCost
WITH bf, collect({target:dTarget, cost:dCost}) AS dj
RETURN size(bf) AS bellmanFordPaths,
       size(dj) AS dijkstraPaths,
       size([b IN bf WHERE NOT any(d IN dj WHERE d.target = b.target AND d.cost = b.cost)]) AS mismatches

parameters.query:
MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation)
WITH count(*) AS directedLinks, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.id < b.id THEN a.id + '|' + b.id ELSE b.id + '|' + a.id END) AS uniquePairs
RETURN directedLinks, uniquePairs, directedLinks - uniquePairs AS duplicateDirections

question: What are the five stations located nearest to Paddington? List the station names in the format ["A", "B", "C"].

tools.name: mcp__gds-agent__get_neo4j_schema

parameters.query: MATCH (p:UndergroundStation) WHERE toLower(p.name) CONTAINS 'paddington' OR toLower(p.display_name) CONTAINS 'paddington' RETURN p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.display_name AS display_name, p.latitude AS latitude, p.longitude AS longitude ORDER BY p.name

MATCH (p:UndergroundStation {name: 'Paddington'}), (s:UndergroundStation)
WHERE s <> p
WITH s, point.distance(
  point({latitude: p.latitude, longitude: p.longitude}),
  point({latitude: s.latitude, longitude: s.longitude})
) AS distance_m
RETURN s.name AS station, round(distance_m) AS distance_m
ORDER BY distance_m ASC, station ASC
LIMIT 5

MATCH (p:UndergroundStation {name: 'Paddington'}), (s:UndergroundStation)
WHERE s <> p
WITH s,
     radians(s.latitude - p.latitude) AS dLat,
     radians(s.longitude - p.longitude) AS dLon,
     radians(p.latitude) AS lat1,
     radians(s.latitude) AS lat2
WITH s, 6371000.0 * 2.0 * asin(sqrt(
  sin(dLat / 2.0) * sin(dLat / 2.0) +
  cos(lat1) * cos(lat2) * sin(dLon / 2.0) * sin(dLon / 2.0)
)) AS distance_m
RETURN s.name AS station, round(distance_m) AS distance_m
ORDER BY distance_m ASC, station ASC
LIMIT 5
